packageRules.description: Major version bumps usually require migration steps. Gate them behind manual approval on the dependency dashboard instead of opening PRs automatically.

CRD apiVersion bumps (kubernetes-api datasource, e.g. ClusterSecretStore -> external-secrets.io/v1) are coupled to operator/CRD upgrades and must never be applied on their own. Require manual approval.

Review all External Secrets changes together in one PR: the Helm chart and the ClusterSecretStore/ExternalSecret/SecretStore apiVersions move in lockstep. The v0.x -> v2.x upgrade needed a coordinated CRD conversion-webhook cleanup and storage migration, so gate this group behind manual approval.

WHY: Listenarr has no stable release yet — upstream only publishes canary-X.Y.Z prereleases (every GitHub release is flagged prerelease, and the only image tags are canary-*). Renovate's default docker versioning can't parse the leading 'canary-' prefix, so it never proposed updates and the pinned tag went stale. This regex versioning teaches Renovate to read the semver out of the tag and treat 'canary' as a prerelease marker. Effect: while we're pinned to a canary tag, Renovate keeps bumping canary->canary (allowed because the current version is itself unstable); once upstream publishes a stable X.Y.Z (or vX.Y.Z) tag, Renovate auto-switches to it (stable outranks any prerelease) and — because default ignoreUnstable then applies to a now-stable pin — it will NOT fall back to newer canaries. WHEN TO REMOVE: once we've migrated the listenarr image to a stable (non-canary) tag, delete this rule; default docker versioning handles plain X.Y.Z tags correctly on its own.
